impact.description: none: no public docs change needed. affected: at least one docs page or mirror needs a change. unsure: you could not tell.

gated.description: True when the user-visible part of this change is behind a feature flag, allowlist, beta gate, or environment gate.

gated_reason.description: The flag or gate and the file that defines it, or an empty string.

summary.description: Two or three plain sentences on what the PR changes for users and why the docs are or are not affected. No links.

items.description: One entry per docs claim that the PR makes wrong or incomplete. Empty when impact is none.

page.description: Path inside the docs repo, e.g. docs/app/api-keys.mdx or static/llms-full.txt.

claim.description: What the page says today, quoted or paraphrased.

change.description: What it should say after this PR.

evidence.description: file:line in the product PR head that decides it, e.g. packages/website/src/pages/ApiKeys.tsx:42.

new_pages.description: Pages that should exist but do not. Usually empty.
